source_of_truth.audit_basis: Finaldesign.zip + frozen mockups + A1-A6 contracts + B1 Overview freeze + B2 existing-pages product-truth sweep + B3 Actions final design + B4 Settings final design + B5 Financial/Report/Monitoring semantics + B6 Landing/Pilot/Pricing/Claims

design_scope.title: Main Landingpage
design_scope.required_fix: B6 final public Product/Claim Truth frozen; D9 migrates production copy and pricing projection, while C2/C3/C5 own Legal, Commerce states and responsive acceptance.

design_scope.title: Pilotpage
design_scope.required_fix: B6 final pilot semantics frozen as controlled pilot, not General Availability or AppSource-live; production implementation remains D9.

design_scope.title: Login
design_scope.required_fix: Runtime/auth implementation remains C1/D8; no further existing-page product decision required

design_scope.title: Dashboard Overview — Free / Assessment / Monitoring
design_scope.required_fix: Product/design truth frozen in B1; runtime implementation remains D6/D7 and final responsive acceptance remains C5

design_scope.title: Findings — Free / Assessment / Monitoring
design_scope.required_fix: Final global component/token alignment remains B7; entitlement gating and BC operational boundaries are fixed by B2

design_scope.title: Actions — Free / Assessment / Monitoring
design_scope.required_fix: B3 final design frozen against remediation contract; runtime Remediation entity/read API/dashboard implementation remain D1/D3/D7

design_scope.title: Financial Impact
design_scope.required_fix: B5 final semantics frozen against fin-v1 and the shared backend financial projection; runtime implementation remains D7.

design_scope.title: Executive Summary Report — HTML + print/PDF
design_scope.required_fix: B5 final report semantics frozen; D10 later supplies one backend data contract for web, HTML and PDF without recalculating financial KPIs.

design_scope.title: Scans
design_scope.required_fix: Read-only history/status page frozen in B2; start, rerun and scope changes remain outside the web dashboard

design_scope.title: Monitoring Detail
design_scope.required_fix: B5 final monitoring semantics frozen: comparable-scope histories only, methodology-version aware, no summed Potential Saving and no Estimated Loss delta labeled as Realized Saving. Runtime remains D7.

design_scope.title: Monitoring Locked — Free / Assessment
design_scope.required_fix: Canonical Monitoring access state frozen in B2; Premium terminology is not allowed

design_scope.title: Settings / Tenant / Security
design_scope.required_fix: B4 final design frozen: only web-owned account preferences are editable; BC/Entra/Notifications remain read-only. Runtime remains D4/D8 and Auth/Onboarding C1.

design_scope.title: Subscription / Billing
design_scope.required_fix: B6 final commerce/product presentation frozen: Assessment and Validation are one-time, Monitoring recurring with monthly/annual variants, prices come from Product Model, and Free Entry is not a subscription. Checkout states remain C3.

design_scope.title: Documentation / Support
design_scope.required_fix: Existing support surface is product-truth safe in B2; B7 may only align final UI tokens/components and must not add phantom API/SLA/support channels

missing_design_scope.title: Invite / Registration / Verification / Password Reset / Access States
Impressum / Datenschutz / Terms / DPA-AVV / Cookie Settings if required
Checkout / Payment / Activation / Cancellation / Invoice states

manual_pilot_gates.en: BC SaaS role matrix: SETUP / SCHEDULER / ADMIN
Real checkout and entitlement grant smoke
SMTP delivery + SPF / DKIM / DMARC / bounce
Final release candidate freeze and sign-off

latest_developments.en: B6 freezes Main Landingpage, Pilotpage and Subscription/Billing at 99%: Product Model is the only pricing authority, Free Entry is not a subscription, financial claims follow fin-v1, money examples must be illustrative, and AppSource/SLA/partner/customer-proof claims require evidence.
latest_developments.de: B6 friert Main Landingpage, Pilotpage und Subscription/Billing bei 99% ein: Das Product Model ist die einzige Pricing-Authority, Free Entry ist kein Abo, Financial Claims folgen fin-v1, Geldbeispiele muessen illustrativ sein und AppSource-/SLA-/Partner-/Customer-Proof-Claims benoetigen Evidence.

latest_developments.en: B5 freezes Financial Impact, Executive Report and Monitoring Detail at 99% on one fin-v1 semantic model: shared backend projection only, no report/client recalculation, legacy roi_eur is not presented as realized ROI, and Realized Saving remains gated.
latest_developments.de: B5 friert Financial Impact, Executive Report und Monitoring Detail bei 99% auf einer einheitlichen fin-v1-Semantik ein: nur gemeinsame Backend-Projektion, keine Report-/Client-Neuberechnung, Legacy roi_eur wird nicht als realisierter ROI dargestellt und Realized Saving bleibt gegated.

latest_developments.en: B4 freezes Settings / Tenant / Security at 99%: only web-owned account preferences are editable; Business Central, tenant-wide Notifications and Entra/identity administration remain read-only summaries.
latest_developments.de: B4 friert Settings / Tenant / Security bei 99% ein: Nur web-owned Account-Praeferenzen sind editierbar; Business Central, tenantweite Notifications und Entra-/Identity-Administration bleiben read-only Zusammenfassungen.

latest_developments.en: Business Central remains the operational write authority while the web dashboard is primarily read-only.
latest_developments.de: Business Central bleibt die operative Write-Authority, während das Web-Dashboard primär read-only ist.
